units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 15:1">Sabb. XV, 1</cite> <he>ק׳ הגמלין</he> a knot like that which the camel drivers make (v. <cite ref="G00534"><he>זְמָמָא</he></cite>); <he>ק׳ הספנין</he> the sailors’ knot (v. <cite ref="A01460"><he>אִיסְטְרִידָא</he></cite>). Ib. 111ᵇ <he>ק׳ שאינו של קיימא</he> a knot which is not intended to be permanent, a temporary knot.
Ber. 7ᵃ ק׳ של תפלין the knot in the band of the T’fillin (resting on the back of the head); a. v. fr.—Trnsf. union, conspiracy.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26a:23">Snh. 26ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 8:12">Is. VIII, 12</cite>) <he>ק׳ רשעים הוא וק׳ רשעים אינו וכ׳</he> it is a council of wicked men &c., v. <cite ref="M01786"><he>מִנְיָן</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>קְשָׁרִים</he>, <he>קְשָׁרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 30b:18">Bekh. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:18">Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>קִשְׁרֵי מוכס</he>, v. <cite ref="M00479"><he>מוֹכֵס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:3">Mikv. X, 3</cite> <he>קשרי העני</he> the knots in the poor man’s garment. Tanḥ. Korah 12 <he>ח׳ חוטין וה׳ ק׳</he> eight threads (of the show fringe) and five knots; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:12">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ח׳ גרורין וה׳ קִשּׁוּרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:9">Sabb. VI, 9</cite> <he>הבנים יוצאין בק׳</he> children may go out (on the Sabbath) with garlands, v. <cite ref="Q00151"><he>פּוּאָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—
Sot. VIII, 5 קשרי המלחמה the joined ranks in battle (Y. ed. קישוי, corr. acc.); Y. ib. VIII, end, 23ᵃ קִישְׁרֵי המלחמות.—2) protuberance, joint.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:1:5">Y. Shebi. III, 34ᶜ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="S02264">preced.</cite>
Gen. R. s. 10 (ref. to Job XXXVIII, 31) כסיל מושך בין ק׳ לק׳ the planet K’sil draws (the connection) between bud and bud (v. עָדַן Hif.); a. e.—Pl. as ab. Y. Shebi. l. c., v. preced.
<cite ref="Niddah 52b:8">Nidd. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>קשרי אצבעותיה של יד</he> the joints of her fingers; <he>של רגל</he> of her toes.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:2:10">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>עד קישרי אצבעותיו</he> to the second joints of the fingers, contrad. to <cite ref="Q01982"><he>פֶּרֶק</he></cite>, q. v.; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 160b:2">B. Bath. 160ᵇ</cite> <he>בין ק׳ לק׳</he> the witnesses sign between the folds; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 160b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מתוך שנתרבה בקְשָׁרָיו וכ׳</he> because it has many folds, it must have many witnesses.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:10">Gitt. VIII, 10</cite> (expl. <he>גט קרח</he>, v. <cite ref="S01966"><he>קֵרֵחַ</he></cite>) <he>כל שקשריו מרובין וכ׳</he> which has more folds than signatures of witnesses; a. fr.
